subject: Post-call: Model fit & multilingual evals for Globex Retail
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Müller <sofia.muller@globexretail.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: Model fit & multilingual evals for Globex Retail

Hi Sofia — thanks again for your time earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

Recap:
- Primary goal: accurate, brand-safe product descriptions and localized customer support responses across EU locales (FR/DE/ES) and select APAC locales (JA/KO).
- Constraints: strict PII redaction requirements, EU data residency for training/eval artifacts, 24-48ms soft latency targets for in-session suggestions.

Recommended baseline models to evaluate:
- redwood-4x (high-throughput, strong multi-lingual capability)
- llama-3-13b-q4f16 (quantized variant for cost-sensitive endpoints)
- small fine-tune candidate: redwood-3.7b-ft (if we proceed to supervised fine-tuning)

What we will deliver for the baseline evals:
- 10k-sample prompt set (stratified by locale and intent) attached as "globex_prompt_set_eu_v1.csv"
- Benchmark report with per-locale metrics (BLEU, INFORM, named-entity preservation, formality preservation) — draft will be shared as PDF
- Eval dashboard link for live results: https://redwood-inference.app/eval-dashboard/GLOBEX-4231

Key quality/regression checks we plan to run:
- Named entity fidelity (product names, SKUs) across FR/DE/ES
- Formality and tone consistency for localized marketing copy
- Safety/brand-safety regressions (hallucination rate on product facts)
- Tokenization and punctuation handling differences for JA/KO

Next steps / ask from you:
1) Confirm we can run evaluations on a de-identified 10k sample (we'll provide the schema and redaction checklist).
2) Any additional locales to include beyond FR/DE/ES/JA/KO?
3) Confirm EU data residency constraint so we route eval artifacts to your EU tenant.

I'll kick off a baseline run as soon as we have confirmation on (1) and (3). Timeline: baseline evals ~ 10 business days; if we move to fine-tuning, estimate 4-6 weeks for a first pass.

Attachments: globex_prompt_set_eu_v1.csv (prompt samples), benchmark_report_eu_apac_q2.pdf (draft), eval_dash_link.txt (dashboard pointer)

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Sofia Müller <sofia.muller@globexretail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-01T10:45:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Model fit & multilingual evals for Globex Retail

Hi Marissa — thanks for the detailed recap. A few follow-ups from my side: 

- FR/DE/ES are must-haves for Q3 pilot. APAC (JA/KO) is nice-to-have; can we run a quick sanity check there but prioritize EU?
- For named-entity fidelity: do you have examples of how the models currently perform on our product SKUs and brand names in FR/DE?
- Rough order of magnitude on fine-tuning cost and any data volume expectations? We likely need procurement sign-off if we go beyond baseline evals.

Sofia Müller
Head of ML Ops, Globex Retail
sofia.muller@globexretail.com
+49 30 555 4422

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-01T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Post-call: Model fit & multilingual evals for Globex Retail

Marissa — forwarding Sofia's questions. Key internal notes: 

- For named-entity fidelity examples, see recent benchmark (attached in drive). Early runs show redwood-4x preserves product SKUs at ~98% in FR/DE, llama-3-13b-q4f16 ~94% (post-tokenization differences).
- Monica: can you prepare the locale-stratified prompt set + evaluation harness (NER/EPO/FORMALITY checks)? Use the attached prompt set as starting point and add edge-case examples for declensions in DE and contractions in FR.
- Also confirm quantized model variant we'll evaluate for cost comparison (llama-3-13b-q4f16).

On quoting Sofia's email: 
> For named-entity fidelity: do you have examples of how the models currently perform on our product SKUs and brand names in FR/DE?

Let's sync briefly (15m) tomorrow so we can respond with concrete numbers and an updated timeline.

Thanks,
Dylan
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Müller <sofia.muller@globexretail.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-02T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Model fit & multilingual evals for Globex Retail

Hi Sofia — answering your points and adding details: 

1) EU priority confirmed. We'll run full baseline on FR/DE/ES and a small sanity check on JA/KO in parallel.

2) Named-entity fidelity examples: I've uploaded a short sample report to the drive and included high-level numbers here: redwood-4x preserves product SKUs ~98% FR/DE, llama-3-13b-q4f16 ~94% (errors are mostly punctuation/tokenization related). We'll include per-SKU examples in the benchmark PDF (attached).

3) Fine-tuning cost & data volume: baseline evals are covered under the POC (no additional cost). Fine-tuning estimates depend on training strategy — for a supervised fine-tune with 50k examples expect a ballpark of $12k-$25k depending on target latency and quantization choices. We can provide a more detailed SOW after scoping.

Timeline updates:
- Baseline evals (full EU locales): ~10 business days after you approve running on the de-identified 10k sample.
- Sanity check for JA/KO: 3-5 business days in parallel.
- Fine-tune (if approved): 4-6 weeks for first pass + validation.

Security & residency: we will store eval artifacts in your EU tenant and redact PII per the checklist. I'll send the redaction schema separately.

Attachments: benchmark_report_eu_apac_q2.pdf, globex_prompt_set_eu_v1.csv 
Dashboard: https://redwood-inference.app/eval-dashboard/GLOBEX-4231 (live once runs start)

If that works, can you reply with a short approval for us to run the baseline on the de-identified sample and confirm EU tenant for storage? Once we have that I'll trigger the eval and share live results to the dashboard.

Best regards,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198
